title: onboard-sirius-30b-v1.0-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Priya Nair
description: Onboard Sirius-30B v1.0 to the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog entries. Motivation: support a new high-quality open model that we've validated across our standard perf harness and provide out-of-the-box runtime profiles for dedicated and hosted deployments. This PR includes: - model metadata (manifest and model card) - perf profiles for common sequence lengths and GPU classes (A100, H100, T4) - quantization recommendation metadata and token cost estimates - automated changelog generation integration so the model appears in the release notes pipeline The description below is a single continuous string and includes checklist items. Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest and model card (metadata) - [x] Generate baseline perf profiles using perf-harness v2 - [x] Add quantization and runtime recommendations - [x] Wire up changelog automation (changelog.yaml + template) - [x] Add unit/integration tests for registry listing and validation - [x] CI green on rerun Notes: Linear ENG-4362 tracks follow-ups for additional GPU families and expanded evals. Related: pr-9123 (elysian onboarding) for similar perf-profile layout and changelog approach.

perf_summary: Baseline perf profiles generated with perf-harness v2.1. Reported P50 and P95 token latencies for seq lengths [128,512,1024] and throughput estimates for 1 and 8 streamer clients. A100 (seq1024) p50 45.2ms/token, H100 (seq1024) p50 32.8ms/token, T4 (seq512) p50 78.1ms/token. Memory working set and KV cache warm/cold deltas included in YAML files.
